# Components

144 public components across 12 families, plus 64 compound sub-parts documented on their parent's page. Every table on every component page is extracted from source by `vue-component-meta@3.3.7`; nothing here is hand-typed.

## Buttons

- [DzButton](./DzButton.md) — Primary button component.
- [DzButtonGroup](./DzButtonGroup.md) — Groups buttons together with shared styling context.
- [DzCopyButton](./DzCopyButton.md) — Clipboard copy button with visual feedback.
- [DzFab](./DzFab.md) — Floating action button.
- [DzIconButton](./DzIconButton.md) — Icon-only button component.
- [DzSpeedDial](./DzSpeedDial.md) — a DzFab that fans out a set of secondary actions.
- [DzSplitButton](./DzSplitButton.md) — Compound split button with primary action + dropdown.
- [DzToggleButton](./DzToggleButton.md) — Toggleable button with pressed state.
